description: `is a <type-word>` with a word that is not a recognized Core type raises `ol-unknown-type` naming the word (spec/execution-model.md:146-166, error-model.md `ol-unknown-type`). Raised at stage=semantic: since issue #815 `execute()` runs the checker before Phase 2, so its copy is the one delivered. The runtime keeps an identical copy at stage=runtime for a caller driving `evaluate()`/`createEnvironment()` directly. The program does not run, so no event is emitted at all; under the `runUnchecked` opt-out execution halts at the failing statement and only its `instruction` event is kept. Issue #99. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's.
